name: Weather alerts
description: Warns you the evening before a storm, heavy rain or snow, so plans outside don't catch you out. Uses Open-Meteo (free for personal use, no key).
author: The Sara team

settings.label: Your city
settings.tip: The city to watch, for example Austin or Lyon. Leave it empty and it stays quiet.
